pitLanes.widthSource: estimated: the paved strip between the pit wall and the garage fronts (OSM Pit Garages 28767014, LIDAR) is about 12 m wide, the garages' fronts 18.7 m from the track's centre; OSM maps the lane about 10 m from the track's centre, so its middle part is moved out to 13 m (track edge 6.5 m + pit wall + half the lane)
pitLanes.modeReason: the entry is on the exit of Clark Curve, fast and blind, and the lane is 7 m shorter than the track (a short cut if open)

gantries.name: start line
gantries.source: driver61.com start/finish coordinates (51 21'37.1"N 0 15'37.2"E), 19 m past the OSM raceway=start-finish node 1825805766 (the finish line); BARC Indy briefing notes: start and finish lines about 20 m apart

gantries.name: Hailwood Hill footbridge
gantries.source: OSM way 842276417 (highway=footway, bridge=covered, layer=1) over Hailwood Hill; LIDAR (EA NLP 2018) shows the span across the whole road, top 7.6-8.0 m
gantries.note: built as the stock footbridge only where its pillars, stairs and bases stand 4 m beyond the road and verge, else as a stock gantry (wfbuild/pits.py _span; Chris 2026-10-25)

gantries.note: built as the stock footbridge only where its pillars, stairs and bases stand 4 m beyond the road and verge, else as a stock gantry (wfbuild/pits.py _span; Chris 2026-10-25)
